mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 5.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises above 5.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in federal funds rate and CPIAUCSL YoY change above 2.5% signals monetary policy response to inflation, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as market anticipates economic resilience.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Strong consumer spending indicated by RSAFS above 450,000 million dollars drives elevated corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing activity, supporting corporate profits and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions and potential wage pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days due to anticipated monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increase in residential housing starts (HOUST > 1000) and consumer spending (RSAFS > 450000) signals robust household demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1000 and RSAFS > 450000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%) triggers market anticipation of aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY change exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
